$comment: Status: Proposed. Generated from asyncapi/*.yaml and maintained by the API Governance Guild; checked by scripts/ci/check-asyncapi-catalog.mjs.

statusValues.contract-only: Contract exists; provider default branch does not publish to Kafka.
statusValues.publishes-legacy: Provider publishes, but to a legacy topic or without the envelope; dual-publish to the contract topics during migration.
statusValues.outbox: Provider publishes the contract topics through a transactional outbox.
statusValues.no-contract: Expected publisher without a contract yet (file is null).
